variants.label: A
variants.name: A-street-remaster.png
variants.prompt: Create a high-quality landscape 16:9 3D game art concept mockup for Rockhop showing a substantially remastered rider AND trials motorbike inside its dusk shutter-door Garage. Image 1 is the current actual Garage: use the corrugated workshop, shutter revealing sunset skyline, concrete floor and restrained teal/cream UI language as context, but do not copy its small hero framing or outdated prices/labels. Image 2 is an older AI target reference: use its full bike mechanical anatomy, human proportions, readable materials and trials silhouette as inspiration only. The hero dominates around 70% of image width, entire rider and both wheels fully in frame, 3/4 side view, controlled studio-quality game lighting, warm rim and cool soft fill, grounded tyres, believable hand-on-grip and foot-on-peg contacts. Render as achievable premium real-time game art, not live-action photography. A compact 'ROCKHOP / GARAGE' header at top left, unobtrusive 'CONCEPT / A ' at lower left; no other labels, stats, prices, UI controls or brand logos. This is a target for a combined Blender mesh/rig cleanup + Hunyuan3D/TRELLIS shape and PBR bake + UniMate motion-authoring pipeline, NOT an output proof. Do not visually depict AI tools. Preserve a compact lightweight trials bike with thin seat, upright engine, spoked wheels, visible chain, swingarm, real brake rotors and fork; no superbike or street-cruiser silhouette. NO invented extra hands, spokes crossing incorrectly, melted machinery, sprawling pipes, huge bodywork, detached feet or photoreal human compositing. Direction A: FAITHFUL STREET REMASTER. Adult male rider with short loose dark curls and subtle authored stubble, mustard hoodie with sculpted cloth folds and clean cuffs, natural denim fit, charcoal sneakers and riding gloves. Keep recognisable street rider identity with clear shoulder, elbow, knee and hand anatomy. Rookie bike blue/white bodywork with brushed alloy frame, crisp engine fins, satin black rubber, fine mechanical detail baked at sensible scale. Relaxed seated idle ready to breathe and glance slightly; hands both on the grips. Quiet premium realism with legible forms.
